title: Principal Product Marketing Manager
description:
Headquarters: Remote US

 Principal Product Marketing Manager — AI Systems & Content Architecture

 The Mission

 As a Principal Product Marketing Manager — AI Systems & Content Architecture, you will determine the architecture of our narrative and collateral engine. Rather than operating as an artisanal, bespoke content creator, your mandate is to establish our foundational positioning architecture and engineer high-leverage, AI-driven workflows that generate enterprise-grade sales collateral at scale. You will own the strategic narrative for Sumo Logic’s Log Analytics Platform across Observability and Security personas, establishing automated knowledge loops, scalable asset generation engines, and self-serve frameworks that allow a focused team to deliver the output and velocity typically associated with a much larger company.

 Strategic Transformation to AI-Led Architecture

• AI-Augmented Asset Production: Replace manual drafting with prompt frameworks and retrieval pipelines to rapidly generate high-impact technical collateral from raw inputs.

• Self-Serve Content Engines: Provide modular asset systems and AI repositories for field teams to dynamically generate persona-aligned collateral on demand.

• Tiered Distribution: Focus full-funnel GTM on high-impact Tier-1 shifts while empowering PMs with self-serve playbooks for Tier-2/3 releases.

• Strategic Systems Architect: Shift from tactical execution to designing the future operating model of Sumo Logic's product marketing engine.

 Core Responsibilities

 1. Strategic Positioning Architecture & Master Messaging

• Establish and govern master narrative, value matrices, and core messaging across Observability and Security audiences.

• Maintain a single source of truth for product capabilities and proof points driving downstream generative tools and campaigns.

• Synthesize technical inputs into buyer-centric value propositions for practitioners and C-suite leaders.

 2. High-Leverage, AI-Augmented Collateral Production

• Modernize creation of sales assets, including solution briefs, pitch decks, white papers, and video scripts.

• Build AI-assisted content pipelines (prompt libraries, RAG, structured templates) converting technical specs into field assets.

• Partner with Sales Enablement to integrate generated collateral into field delivery tools and LMS platforms.

 3. Self-Serve Field Content Systems & Modular Asset Kits

• Design modular presentation kits allowing AEs and SEs to independently assemble stage-specific decks.

• Maintain a searchable knowledge repository of approved copy blocks, proof points, and architectural diagrams.

• Replace ad-hoc collateral requests with structured intake, template updates, and self-serve workflows.

 4. Tiered GTM Launch Frameworks

• Enforce a disciplined GTM release tiering system to optimize team bandwidth and commercial impact.

• Drive cross-functional GTM strategies and core collateral packages for Tier-1 flagship innovations.

• Provide self-serve launch toolkits for Product Managers to document routine Tier-2/3 feature updates.

• Own end-to-end launch readiness and coordination across a portfolio of programs, from planning through post-launch measurement. Build and apply AI-powered workflows, such as automated launch tracking, content drafting, messaging QA, and stakeholder updates, to scale your impact and free up time for strategic work.

 Qualifications & Experience

• Domain Credibility: 10+ years of experience in Product Marketing within complex B2B SaaS, log analytics, cloud infrastructure, observability, or cybersecurity market segments.

• PMM Craftsmanship: Deep, hands-on experience crafting high-converting sales presentations, technical white papers, solution briefs, and persona-aligned value propositions.

• AI & Workflow Fluency: Practical enthusiasm and hands-on capability with modern generative AI tools to structure prompt chains, synthesize technical input, and scale content generation workflows.

• Systems Mindset: A builder who naturally defaults to creating reusable templates, standardized blocks, and self-serve frameworks rather than writing one-off documents from scratch.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to partner effectively with Product Management on technical inputs, and with dedicated Sales Enablement partners on field distribution.

 About Us

 Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com.

 Sumo Logic Privacy Policy . Employees will be responsible for complying with applicable federal privacy laws and regulations, as well as organizational policies related to data protection.

 The expected annual base salary range for this position is $198,000 - $232,000. Compensation varies based on a variety of factors which include (but aren’t limited to) role level, skills and competencies, qualifications, knowledge, location, and experience. In addition to base pay, certain roles are eligible to participate in our bonus or commission plans and equity awards. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan, and paid time off.

 This position will remain open until filled; there is no application deadline. To be considered, please submit your application.

 Must be authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and for the duration of employment. At this time, we are not able to offer new non-immigrant visa sponsorship or OPT hiring for this position.

title: Partner Marketing Program Manager
description:
Headquarters: Remote USA

 Sumo Logic is seeking a highly organized, analytical, and process-driven Partner Marketing Program Manager to support the growth and operational effectiveness of our global partner marketing organization.

 This role will be responsible for managing the systems, processes, and governance that power our partner marketing programs, with a primary focus on our Partner Relationship Management (PRM) platform, Market Development Funds (MDF), partner program operations, and performance reporting.

 The ideal candidate brings experience in B2B technology channel marketing, understands the complexities of working with MSSPs, VARs, and distributors, and thrives on building scalable processes that improve efficiency, accountability, and business impact.

 This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys bringing structure to complex programs, improving operational workflows, and enabling regional teams and partners to execute successfully.

 What Success Looks Like

 In this role, success means:

• Establishing a reliable, well-managed PRM platform that supports global partner marketing needs.

• Improving partner and internal team adoption of Impartner.

• Implementing consistent MDF governance, approval processes, and financial tracking.

• Providing accurate, timely visibility into MDF spending, utilization, and program performance.

• Reducing manual processes and administrative delays across partner marketing operations.

• Improving partner accountability and reporting of marketing-generated opportunities and pipeline.

• Enabling regional marketing teams to execute programs efficiently through standardized tools and processes.

• Building scalable operational foundations that support Sumo Logic’s growing global partner ecosystem.

 Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in B2B technology marketing, partner marketing, channel operations, or marketing program management.

• Hands-on experience working with Partner Relationship Management (PRM) platforms, preferably Impartner.

• Demonstrated experience managing MDF programs, including funding requests, approvals, budget tracking, governance, and reporting.

• Understanding of MSSP, VAR, and distributor (DISTI) partner ecosystems.

• Experience managing program budgets, financial tracking, and reconciliation processes.

• Strong understanding of channel marketing operations and partner program workflows.

• Experience with Salesforce and familiarity with marketing automation platforms.

• Strong analytical skills and experience developing dashboards, reports, and performance metrics.

• Excellent organizational, project management, and process improvement skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and coordinate stakeholders across global teams.

• Strong attention to detail, financial accuracy, and operational accountability.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to work independently and proactively identify opportunities for improvement.

 Preferred Qualifications

• Direct experience administering Impartner, including MDF workflows and partner portal management.

• Experience developing or implementing MDF governance frameworks and standardized approval processes.

• Experience supporting global partner marketing programs across North America, EMEA, and APJ.

• Familiarity with two-tier distribution models and partner marketing programs involving MSPs, MSSPs, VARs, and distributors.

• Experience with Salesforce reporting, partner attribution, and pipeline tracking.

• Experience supporting PRM integrations, workflow automation, and data quality initiatives.

• Background in cybersecurity, SaaS, cloud, observability, or enterprise technology.

• Experience developing partner enablement materials and training programs.

 About Us

 Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com.

 Sumo Logic Privacy Policy . Employees will be responsible for complying with applicable federal privacy laws and regulations, as well as organizational policies related to data protection.

 The expected annual base salary range for this position is $130,000. Compensation varies based on a variety of factors which include (but aren’t limited to) role level, skills and competencies, qualifications, knowledge, location, and experience. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan, and paid time off.

title: Care Team Intake Specialist
description:
Headquarters: Remote

 About Synapticure

 Synapticure is the largest, most comprehensive specialty care and life sciences company in the country for those living with neurodegenerative diseases. Founded by patients and caregivers living with these diseases, we are redefining the care and the research paradigm for conditions like Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, and ALS in all 50 states.

 Our business is powered by two connected engines.

 The CARES Engine (Clinical Operations)

 A scalable, 50-state virtualized clinical network providing timely access to expert neurologists and cutting edge treatments with wraparound care coordination and behavioral health support. Our team creates personalized care plans focused on education and empowerment, connecting patients with a multidisciplinary team of subspecialty neurologists, geriatricians, psychologists, and care coordinators who collaborate to deliver comprehensive care.

 The CURES Engine (Research & Innovation)

 Leveraging our deeply engaged, well characterized national patient cohort, CURES partners with life science, pharma, biotech, and medical device companies to accelerate the development of neurodegenerative treatments, spanning discovery stage lab services, clinical trial services, and real world evidence data and analytics.

 Partnering with providers, health plans, and life sciences companies, including CMS' GUIDE dementia care model, Synapticure is dedicated to transforming the lives of millions of individuals and their families living with neurodegenerative diseases.
 About the Role

 Synapticure is dedicated to ensuring all individuals living with neurodegenerative diseases have equitable access to the highest standard of care while fueling the advancement of personalized treatments. We create a guided, compassionate journey for every patient, caregiver, and family, educating and empowering them while facilitating access to critical tests and leading specialists across the United States.

 As a Care Team Intake Specialist, you will be the welcoming first point of contact for members, caregivers, and loved ones navigating neurodegenerative conditions. You will drive essential clinical and administrative support functions, including scheduling, registration, referrals, and prior authorizations, serving as a trusted representative of Synapticure to our members, external healthcare organizations, and payer partners.

 This is an opportunity to make a meaningful, daily impact on people's lives within a mission-driven, rapidly evolving environment. We are looking for an empathetic, curious, and organized communicator who thrives in collaborative spaces and is committed to delivering respectful, culturally responsive, and accessible care to diverse communities.

 The Day to Day

 Member Engagement & Care Coordination

• Conduct welcoming, empathetic intake calls with new patients and caregivers to gather medical histories, current and past provider details, and insurance information.

• Schedule, confirm, and manage clinical appointments across virtual platforms, ensuring daily scheduling benchmarks and protocols are met.

• Proactively manage cancellations, rescheduling requests, and appointment reminders via phone, video, and digital communication tools.

• Collaborate closely with the multidisciplinary care team to coordinate care, complete visit-related tasks, and execute FMLA forms.

• Advocate on behalf of patients and families with clinical providers, billing departments, and insurance partners while maintaining strict adherence to HIPAA guidelines.

 Operations, Documentation & Follow-Up

• Request, collect, and audit external medical records, member consents, and HIPAA forms to ensure care teams have complete information prior to appointments.

• Conduct insurance eligibility checks and assist with prior authorizations and referral management.

• Accurately document member clinical and demographic data, calls, and correspondence in our Electronic Health Record (EHR) and care facilitation platforms in a timely manner.

• Manage incoming and outgoing communications, including faxes, digital messages, and mailed member resources.

• Follow standardized operating procedures and quality assurance protocols while remaining adaptable to evolving workflows and priorities.

• Generate standard operational reports and support additional care team initiatives as needed.

 Minimum Qualifications

• 1-2+ years of experience in patient communication, care coordination, medical scheduling, or managing referrals and prior authorizations.

• Comfort with digital communication tools, telehealth platforms, Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems, and standard office technology.

• Working knowledge of HIPAA privacy guidelines and handling confidential medical records.

• Strong active listening skills and the ability to communicate clearly, patiently, and non-judgmentally with individuals from diverse backgrounds and varying accessibility needs.

• Ability to stay organized, prioritize tasks effectively, and adapt in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

 Preferred Qualifications

• 3+ years of experience in a healthcare setting, such as a Medical Assistant (MA), Patient Care Coordinator, Medical Records Specialist, or similar clinical/administrative support role.

• Familiarity with healthcare operations, medical terminology, FMLA documentation, and frequently prescribed medications.

• Experience requesting, reviewing, and auditing external medical records for completeness and accuracy.

• Hands-on proficiency with cloud-based EHR systems (e.g., Epic, Athenahealth, eClinicalWorks), macOS, and Google Workspace.

• Experience working in a remote setting, startup, or mission-driven organization undergoing rapid growth and change.

 Schedule
 We are looking for candidates who are flexible to work the below schedule, based on your time zone, Monday through Friday.

• Pacific: 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM PT

• Mountain: 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM MT

• Central: 10:00 AM to 6:30 PM CT

• Eastern: 11:00 AM to 7:30 PM ET
 Compensation

 Final compensation will be determined based on location, experience, and qualifications.

 Our Values

 We are a remote-first company. While our team is located all across the United States, these core principles tie us together around a common identity:

• Relentless focus on patients and caregivers : We are determined to provide an exceptional experience for every patient we have the privilege to serve, and we put our patients first in everything we do.

• Embody the spirit and humanity of those living with neurodegenerative disease : Inspired by our founders, families, and personal experiences, we recognize the seriousness of our patients' circumstances and meet that challenge every day with empathy, compassion, kindness, joy, and hope.

• Seek to understand, and stay curious : We start by listening to one another, our partners, our patients, and their caregivers. We communicate with authenticity and humility, prioritizing honesty and directness while recognizing we always have something to learn.

• Embrace the opportunity : We are energized by the importance of our mission and maintain a strong bias toward action.

 Benefits & Perks

 Full time employees are eligible for:

• Remote First : Work from anywhere in the 50 United States, with home office technology provided.

• Comprehensive Healthcare : Medical, dental, and vision insurance options for you and your family.

• Financial & Retirement Support : 401(k) plan with employer matching, plus short and long-term disability, and basic and supplemental life insurance.

• Time Off & Leave : 15 vacation days, 5 sick days, 12 paid holidays, and 2 floating holidays, plus a fully paid end-of-year company holiday break (typically Christmas through New Year's).

• Wellness & Family Growth : Comprehensive family-building and fertility services through Kindbody (where available) at a 20% discount, 24/7 mental health support via Health Advocate and Talkspace (including 12 free on-demand sessions per year), and access to One Medical.

 Travel Requirements & Remote Workplace Setup

 We're a remote-first company and provide the necessary technology to work from home. Most roles involve only occasional travel, such as for team meetings or professional collaboration events, unless otherwise specified in the job-specific details above.

 Equal Opportunity Employer

 Synapticure is an equal opportunity employer and a remote-first workplace. We believe that embedding equity, inclusion, compliance, and operational excellence across all aspects of our employee lifecycle directly reflects our core values. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Please apply even if you feel you do not meet all qualifications.

 At this time, Synapticure is unable to provide work visa sponsorship.

 If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to careers@synapticure.com.

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/synapticure-care-team-intake-specialist

title: Resolution Response Specialist
description:
Headquarters: Remote

 Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com

 An award-winning culture working towards an important mission – Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including:

• TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026)

• Fortune Change the World (2024)

• CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024)

• Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024)

• Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024)

• Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023)

• Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)

 About the Role:

 Maven is looking for a Resolution Response Specialist who will lead the end-to-end resolution of complex, high-risk member escalations, serving as a Tier 2 senior owner within the Resolution Response Team to ensure every escalation is handled consistently, efficiently, and at the right level the first time — restoring member trust while protecting Maven, its clients, and its members.

 This is a non-exempt, Monday–Friday position with hours of 8:30 a.m.–5:00 p.m. ET and occasional weekend coverage as needed.

 What You’ll Do:

• Own escalated member cases end-to-end, serving as the single accountable owner for moderate-to-high complexity issues across billing, reimbursement, benefits, coordination of benefits, network exceptions, and service breakdowns.

• Conduct structured investigations using the established triage framework (Category → Owner → Macro → Checklist → SLA → Escalation Path), reviewing ticket history, call recordings, prior guidance, client documentation, spend, and reimbursement records before resolution.

• Lead service recovery by reviewing low-rated interactions, conducting proactive outreach (call-first where possible), applying de-escalation protocols, and confirming closed-loop resolution with a written member recap.

• Serve as the primary cross-functional bridge across MBS, Support, Care Delivery, Client Success, Payment Operations, Network Operations, Product, Engineering, and Legal/Compliance to coordinate corrective action and accelerate resolution.

• Communicate with members using approved macros and empathy-led, legally protective language; provide CSMs with concise case summaries and polished client-facing messaging when needed.

• Identify and route risk using Critical/High/Standard severity and SEV 2/SEV 3 legal protocols for legal, compliance, discrimination, or regulatory exposure.

• Maintain precise documentation in Zendesk and the escalation tracker, applying granular themes, reason codes, and ownership tags to enable reliable root-cause reporting.

• Identify escalation trends and drive macro, playbook, and process improvements that reduce recurrence and prevent repeat escalations.

 What You’ll Bring:

• Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, Communications, or related field preferred, or equivalent experience; 3+ years in escalation management, member/customer advocacy, health benefits, or healthcare operations.

• Experience resolving complex, multi-stakeholder escalations; strong knowledge of employer-sponsored benefits, reimbursement and claims workflows, and the fertility/family-building member journey.

• Familiarity with Zendesk, Jira, Guru, Google Sheets, and Looker.

• Highly organized and detail-oriented, with strong critical thinking, root-cause analysis, and structured case management skills.

• Excellent verbal and written communication, with strong de-escalation skills and the ability to translate complex benefits and billing issues into clear resolution plans.

• Sound legal and risk judgment, with the ability to identify when to involve Legal, Compliance, or leadership and collaborate effectively across teams.

• Empathetic, composed, and member-centric, with the ability to navigate high-emotion, high-stakes cases through resolution.

 The base salary range for this role is $82,000 - $96,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, and skillset.

 This role requires active work authorization in the US.

 Maven embraces a flexible and inclusive work environment. This role is open to candidate in: AZ, DC, DE, FL, GA, HI, IL, KS, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MO, NC, NJ, NM, NV, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA, VT, WI. Maven is committed to supporting remote team members with the tools and collaborative culture needed to thrive regardless of location. This policy reflects our belief that great work can happen anywhere and that flexibility enables our team to do their best work.
 At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams.

 Benefits That Work For You

 Our benefits are designed to support your health, well-being and career development, helping you thrive both personally and professionally. We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits:

• Maven for Mavens: access to the full platform and specialists, including care for mental health, reproductive health, family planning and pediatrics.

• Whole-self care through wellness partnerships

• Hybrid work, in office meals, and work together days

• 16 weeks 100% paid parental leave and new parent stipend (for Mavens who've been with us for 1 year+)

• Annual professional development stipend and access to a personal career coach through Maven for Mavens

• 401K matching for US-based employees, with immediate vesting

 These benefits are applicable to Maven Clinic Co., US-based, full-time employees only. 1099/Contract Providers are ineligible for these benefits.

 Maven is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Maven is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Maven Clinic interview requests and job offers only originate from an @mavenclinic.com email address (e.g jsmith@mavenclinic.com). Maven Clinic will never ask for sensitive information to be delivered over email or phone. If you receive a scam issue or a security issue involving Maven Clinic please notify us at: security@mavenclinic.com . For general and additional inquiries, please contact us at careers@mavenclinic.com .

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/maven-clinic-resolution-response-specialist

title: Level 1 Teaching Assistant
description:
Job Title: Teaching Assistant – Level 1 

Actual Annual Salary: £18,605 - £20,279 Based on hours and week worked 

Full Time Equivalent Salary: £26,798 - £29,208 (CLF Grade B) Based on full time hours, all year round. 

Contract Type: Fixed Term Contract

Contract Length: Fixed Until 23 July 2027

Hours: 30 hours per week - Part Time, Term Time Only plus Inset days  

Additional information: This role is for 30 hours per week, worked over five days, comprising 6.5 hours per day Monday to Thursday and 4 hours on Friday. Working hours will be aligned to the operational needs of the Academy and the requirements of the role supporting pupils within The Anchor provision.

Potential Start Date: January 2027 (Subject to completion of pre-employment checks) 

An opportunity to empower students to reach their full potential by delivering tailored support that enhances learning, engagement, and well-being. 

An exciting opportunity to make a meaningful difference in the lives of pupils with Special Educational Needs and Disabilities (SEND) by providing tailored support that promotes learning, independence, wellbeing, and personal success. 

Waycroft Academy is seeking a dedicated and enthusiastic Teaching Assistant to join our team on a fixed-term basis, working primarily within The Anchor, our specialist provision supporting pupils with additional SEND needs. This rewarding role is ideal for someone who is passionate about inclusive education and committed to helping every child thrive both academically and personally. 

The successful candidate will work closely with teachers, SEND colleagues, and other professionals to provide high-quality support for pupils with a range of additional needs. You will be confident working independently and as part of a collaborative team, adapting your approach to meet the individual needs of learners and supporting them to access the curriculum, develop confidence, and achieve their full potential. 

You will provide support within the classroom, in small group settings, and through targeted one-to-one interventions, helping pupils to overcome barriers to learning and engage positively in school life. The role will involve supporting pupils' educational, social, emotional, and communication needs, implementing personalised strategies, and contributing to a nurturing and structured learning environment. 

This position would suit an individual who is patient, adaptable, and committed to promoting inclusion. You will play a key role in helping pupils develop independence, resilience, and self-esteem while supporting positive outcomes that enable them to succeed both within school and beyond. 

About You 

We are looking for someone who: 

  • Is committed to inclusion and ensuring every child feels valued, supported and able to succeed. 
  • Can work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team. 
  • Has a genuine passion for improving the life chances of children and helping them reach their full potential. 
  • Understands the role of a Teaching Assistant and how to support pupils' learning, development and wellbeing within the classroom. 
  • Can build positive relationships with pupils, colleagues, parents and carers. 
  • Can engage and motivate children on a one-to-one basis and within small groups, using positive behaviour management strategies. 
  • Demonstrates patience, empathy, resilience and emotional intelligence when supporting children with a wide range of needs. 
  • Is adaptable and confident in supporting pupils of different ages, abilities and developmental stages, including those with additional needs. 
  • Has strong communication, organisational and interpersonal skills. 
  • Is committed to safeguarding, equality, diversity and promoting the welfare of children and young people. 
  • Holds GCSE English and Maths (Grade C/4 or above) or equivalent, and is willing to undertake relevant training and qualifications to support ongoing development. 

Applicants are advised to refer to the full requirements of the role in the attached job description and person specification, prior to submitting an application.   

About Waycroft Academy: 

Waycroft Academy is a welcoming two-form entry primary school with nursery provision for two, three and four-year-olds, located in the heart of Stockwood, Bristol. Set within extensive grounds, our school offers rich opportunities for outdoor learning that enhance children’s curiosity, well-being and enjoyment of school life. 

We are committed to delivering a broad and balanced curriculum while placing equal importance on the personal development of every child. During our most recent Ofsted inspection, inspectors recognised this strength, commenting: “Staff provide extensive pastoral support. Pupils have wide-ranging experiences to develop their character. Staff champion pupils’ physical and mental well-being.” 

Our shared values of Ready, Respectful and Resilient underpin everything we do and are lived by all members of our school community. Waycroft Academy is a caring, inclusive environment where children and staff support one another to succeed and thrive. 

Why work at CLF?   

We are a diverse and inclusive community of 37 academies across five cluster regions in the South West that is committed to excellence and making a positive impact. Our people bring unique perspectives, but we’re all driven by a shared moral purpose and a passion for making a positive impact, whether in a teaching, leadership or support role. We’re proud to foster a culture where everyone can thrive, feel valued, and make a meaningful difference to the lives of others.   

We are an equal opportunity employer and proud to serve a diverse student population and our communities. We strongly believe that representation matters and so encourage applications from underrepresented and global majority groups including ethnicity, gender, transgender, age, disability, sexual orientation or religion.  

We aim to remove any barriers to employment, ensuring everyone can compete on equal terms. Job share, part-time and flexible working opportunities will be considered. 

What we can offer you: 

  • Access to a generous pension through the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS). 
  • Generous annual leave. 
  • A comprehensive induction and ongoing commitment to wellbeing and career progression, through a range of training, apprenticeships and in-role/wider-trust development opportunities. 
  • Well-being support through an Employee Assistance Programme. 
  • Health benefits, including wellness sessions, gym discounts, and flu jabs. 
  • A range of generous family leave options, including above industry average occupational maternity pay. 
  • Additional benefits like cycle to work scheme, on-site parking plus many more! 

Recruitment timeline:   

  • Closing Date: 06 December 2026 @11.59pm 
  • Shortlisting date: 07 December 2026 
  • Interviews: 14 December 2026 

We welcome visits from potential candidates. If you would like to arrange a school visit prior to the closing date, please contact the academy/site directly to arrange a suitable appointment.   

As part of our commitment to Keeping Children Safe in Education (KCSIE), we do not accept CVs – a full education and employment history must be provided through our application form.    

Please note we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.   

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early, should we receive a high level of interest in the role. Therefore, candidates are advised to apply at their earliest convenience to avoid missing out.     

As a Disability Confident Committed Employer, we are dedicated to equity and inclusion and commit to interviewing applicants with a disability who meet the essential criteria. title: Verbal Behaviour Tutor
description:
The Avenue School is a growing school, expanding to reach full capacity of 104 places serving the needs of pupils with autism and complex needs.

Our Trust mission: ‘love, learn, laugh’, underpins our key aim to improve our pupils’ lives and outcomes through outstanding educational practice and provision, while also setting challenging and aspirational goals designed to empower our pupils and enhance their life choices. The education and well-being we provide depends on forging excellent partnerships between home and school. ​

We strongly believe that school is the opportunity for children to discover and unlock hidden talents in a fun and nurturing environment, as we believe every child has the ability to do amazing things if a school provides the right opportunities.

We are seeking to appoint Verbal Behaviour Tutor to join our school, where we strive to ensure our environment supports children to be happy, safe and educated in a tailored manner in order for them to achieve their potential.

Here's a video to give you an idea of what it's like to work at The RPT and The Avenue School

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VRsSaxsqk5o

What is Verbal Behaviour?

Verbal Behaviour is an approach that applies behavioural principles to language development.

Teaching methodologies used are evidence based and developed from an initial text written by Skinner.

Verbal Behaviour focusses on the reasons why we engage in different types of communication.

It helps us identify areas of communication that our pupils find difficult and how to teach them most effectively

Verbal Behaviour doesn’t just have to be vocal communication.

Individuals can engage in Verbal Behaviour in multiple modes using sign language, communication books, electronic devices etc.

All of our teaching is delivered in the context of the Multi-Agency Support the individual receives.

We are looking for:

Positive, energetic and creative learning support and teaching assistants with a love of teaching and learning;

Applicants who have a keen interest in developing skills in Verbal Behaviour;

Learning support and Teaching assistants who have experience in positively managing behaviour;

Experience or knowledge of autism and/or severe learning difficulties an advantage.

Applicants who are interested in building on their knowledge and understanding in evidence based teaching methods (or in Verbal Behaviour/ABA).

For further information on the role please view the Job Description and Person Specification.

We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare and education of our children and expect all our staff to share this commitment.

An enhanced DBS check and references will be required.

The advertised role is not eligible for visa sponsorship, only applicants with the automatic right to work in the UK should apply.

The Rise Partnership Trust take its’ responsibilities in relation to safeguarding and child protection very seriously. All appointments to the school are subject to Enhanced Disclosure by the Disclosure and Barring Service and comprehensive pre-employment checks.

This post is exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 and therefore applicants are required to declare:

All unspent convictions and conditional cautions

All spent convictions and adult cautions that are not protected (i.e. that are not filtered out) as defined by the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 (Exceptions) Order 1975 (as amended in 2020).

For further information on filtering please refer to Nacro guidance and the guidance issued by the Ministry of Justice (see, in particular, the section titled ‘Exceptions Order’).

It is an offence to apply for the role if you are barred from engaging in regulated activity relevant to children. All shortlisted applicants will be required to complete self-disclosure form and return prior to interview

description:
About Ping Identity:

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.

At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

As a Ping Incident Escalations Manager, you will provide Level 2 incident response and escalation support within the Cyber Security Engineering team. You will help coordinate complex security incidents, improve incident readiness, and ensure that lessons learned are converted into practical improvements.

This is an individual contributor role, combining technical incident response experience with strong operational coordination. You will work closely with CSE engineers and cross-functional teams to maintain momentum during incidents, support tabletop exercises, and improve our incident response capability.

You will

  • Act as a Level 2 escalation point for CSE engineers during complex or high-risk security incidents
  • Coordinate incident response across Cyber Security, Engineering, Infrastructure, Cloud, IT, Product, and other relevant teams
  • Establish incident priorities, ownership, actions, dependencies, and communication cadence
  • Support investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, and validation activities
  • Maintain accurate incident timelines, decision records, action logs, and stakeholder updates
  • Prepare and support cyber security tabletop exercises, including scenarios, injects, facilitation, and follow-up actions
  • Develop and improve incident response playbooks, runbooks, escalation paths, and readiness procedures
  • Lead or support post-incident reviews and ensure lessons learned are converted into tracked improvements
  • Identify recurring response gaps, operational risks, and opportunities for automation or process improvement
  • Participate in the Cyber Security Engineering on-call or escalation rota, where required
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to improve incident response readiness and security outcomes

Requirements

  • Experience in cyber security engineering, incident response, security operations, SRE, or technical operations
  • Experience responding to or coordinating security incidents involving multiple teams
  • Strong operational judgement and the ability to make decisions under pressure and with incomplete information
  • Experience acting as an incident lead, technical lead, escalation point, or senior responder
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical risk clearly to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Experience creating or improving incident response playbooks, runbooks, procedures, or post-incident reviews

  • Strong understanding of cloud environments, preferably AWS and/or GCP
  • Understanding of enterprise and SaaS operational environments
  • On-call and escalation participation is a requirement for this position

You have an advantage if:

  • Experience with Google SecOps and YARA-L
  • Experience with security orchestration, automation, and bespoke scripting
  • Experience working with Kubernetes and Docker in development or incident response contexts
  • Experience with threat intelligence, detection engineering, EDR, identity response, or cloud forensics
  • Experience improving incident response maturity, operational metrics, or security operating procedures

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day.

What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 17M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

Reports to: Manager, Community

Location: Remote UK

Compensation Range: £68,000 to £78,000 base plus bonus and equity

What You'll Do:

You are the person who brings Huntress to life in the room. You travel to roadshows, tradeshows, and other events, meet people who didn't plan to meet you, and turn genuine conversations into momentum for the business. Give More Than We Take shows up in the way you create value first, listen closely, and build relationships that feel human rather than transactional.

You are Outcome-Obsessed about creating meaningful engagements at events from the moment you leave your house to the moment you return, knowing that booth hours are just the tip of the iceberg. You make sure the right prospects receive thoughtful follow-up, account executives get the context they need, and qualified conversations become fully booked demo opportunities. You take ownership of the details, spot what is missing, and use sound judgment when the process needs to bend to serve the customer and the team.

Responsibilities:

  • Travel to assigned roadshows, tradeshows, and other events up to 60% of the time while representing Huntress with energy, professionalism, and a clear understanding of the audience.
  • Drive meaningful traffic to the Huntress booth with pre-event outreach, and by starting conversations, engaging attendees, and creating reasons for the right people to stop and learn more.
  • Execute on-site activations and feet-on-the-street account-based marketing activities as directed by your manager.
  • Build genuine relationships with prospects and partners, in transit, in hallways, over drinks, over dinner, at the booth, at event receptions and parties. Wherever the MSPs are, that’s where you’ll be found.
  • Drive interest through thoughtful conversation, and book demos at in-person events.
  • Manage event follow-up and relationship progression so account executives receive timely context, clear next steps, and strong opportunities to pursue.
  • Use AI tools to research target accounts, prepare for conversations, organize event notes, and draft timely follow-up while applying sound judgment to the final work.

What You Bring to the Team:

  • Experience engaging prospects at tradeshows, roadshows, conferences, or other in-person events is valuable.
  • You are curious, self-starting, eager to learn, driven, and comfortable taking initiative without waiting for perfect instructions.
  • You can engage strangers naturally, make small talk that leads somewhere useful, and build relationships without making the interaction feel transactional.
  • You are travel-ready and comfortable working in environments that require frequent movement, quick judgment, and consistent energy.
  • You are detail-oriented and able to follow a process while recognizing when the situation calls for a thoughtful deviation.
  • You use AI to work faster and smarter in day-to-day preparation, research, and follow-up, with good judgment about accuracy, privacy, and when human context matters most.

What We Offer:

  • 100% remote work environment - since our founding in 2015
  • New starter home office set up reimbursement (£398)
  • Generous personal leave entitlements
  • Digital monthly reimbursement (£92)
  • Travel to the US 1-2 times/year for various company events
  • Pension
  • Access to the BetterUp platform for coaching, personal, and professional growth

Huntress is committed to creating a culture of inclusivity where every single member of our team is valued, has a voice, and is empowered to come to work every day just as they are.

We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status.

We do discriminate against hackers who try to exploit businesses of all sizes.

 About Ping Identity:

 At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.

 Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.

 While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.

 We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100.  The Role:

 As the Director of Sales Engineering, Southern Europe you will take a senior role in shaping how we engage with customers, partners, and the wider sales organisation. You will lead a small team of Sales Engineers, guiding their development and ensuring they are well equipped to succeed, while continuing to spend most of your time working directly on high value opportunities.

 This is a senior hands on leadership role. You will set technical direction for key accounts, influence deal strategy, and help resolve complex architectural questions. You will act as a trusted advisor to customers and sales teams, while also representing the SE function in regional planning, forecasting, and cross functional discussions.

 You will lead by example, taking ownership of strategic opportunities and stepping in where your experience can make a meaningful difference to outcomes. At the same time, you will coach your team to grow their own expertise and confidence, creating an environment where they can perform at a high level.

 Main Responsibilities:

 Leadership & Team Development

• Lead and support a team of Sales Engineers (SE's), providing coaching, regular feedback, and career development

• Set clear expectations for technical quality, customer engagement, and opportunity execution

• Help onboard and mentor new team members and strengthen consistent ways of working across the region

• Partner with regional sales leadership to ensure SE resources are aligned with priority accounts

• Maintain a healthy, collaborative team culture

• Take ownership of strategic and complex opportunities that benefit from senior technical leadership

• Deliver solution demonstrations, discovery sessions, technical guidance, RFx responses, and proofs of concept

• Guide technical strategy across multiple deals

• Act as an escalation point for technical challenges during critical deal phases

• Build trusted relationships with customers and partners, becoming a technical advisor they rely on

• Work closely with sales teams throughout qualification, discovery, and technical proof phases

• Coordinate pre sales efforts with post sales delivery teams to ensure smooth handovers and clear expectations

• Represent Ping Identity at customer meetings, executive briefings, partner events, and industry sessions

 Cross Functional Influence

• Provide insight into market trends, customer challenges, and developing areas.

• Share well reasoned product feedback with product owners and help shape regional solution positioning

• Support strategic planning and forecasting discussions with regional sales leadership

• Work with marketing and product teams to refine competitive messaging and technical narratives

 Skills & Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience of managing sales engineering teams in France, and preferably also Iberia & Italy

• Strong understanding of IAM concepts, architectures, and protocols. Experience with standards such as OAuth, OIDC, SAML, and SCIM is helpful

• Proficiency with REST APIs and JSON, and familiarity with one or more modern programming or scripting languages

• Solid understanding of core infrastructure technologies, including networking, DNS, HTTP/S, load balancing, proxies, and virtualisation

• Experience with major cloud platforms, such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, and deployment technologies like Kubernetes and Terraform

• Understanding of how customers are using agentic AI and how identity secures AI agents, their permissions, and their behaviour

• Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to technical and non technical audiences

• Ability to work independently while also supporting and elevating a team

• Comfortable managing multiple priorities without losing focus on key opportunities

• A genuine interest in learning and staying current in a fast evolving technical landscape

• BS in Software Engineering or equivalent degree

• Fluent French language skills

• Eligibility to work in France

 Life at Ping:

 We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day.

 Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:

• A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.

• Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.

• Regular company and team bonding events.

• Competitive benefits and perks.

• Global volunteering and community initiatives

 Our Benefits:

• Parental Leave

• Retirement Programs

• Commuter Offset (Specific locations)

 Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone’s individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self.

 We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. title: Head of Technology & Data Partnerships
description:
Headquarters: United States, Remote

 Our Mission:

 6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

 Our People:

 People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

 The Opportunity

 This is an enterprise-level leadership role responsible for defining and leading the company’s technology, data, and AI partnership strategy.

 The role will serve as the executive owner of the broader technology and data partnership ecosystem.

 This is not a traditional channel or alliances sales role. The focus is on partnerships that shape the product, strengthen the company’s data advantage, and extend the reach of the platform.

 The leader will help determine where the company should build, buy, partner, or potentially acquire capabilities.

 What the Leader Will Own

• Set the company-wide strategy for technology, data, platform, integration, and AI partnerships.

• Identify a focused portfolio of high-impact partnership opportunities that can improve product differentiation, innovation, distribution, and growth.

• Build trusted C-suite relationships with priority technology platforms, data providers, cloud companies, and emerging AI ecosystems.

• Originate and negotiate complex, multi-year agreements covering product scope, data rights, intellectual property, economics, investment, exclusivity, and governance.

• Shape the external data strategy, including data coverage, quality, identity, signals, licensing, and differentiated data products.

• Influence product and platform strategy by bringing an external ecosystem and market perspective into company investment decisions.

• Partner closely with Product and Engineering to ensure strategic agreements translate into funded roadmaps, clear ownership, successful launches, and measurable customer adoption.

• Establish portfolio governance, performance measures, and an operating model that allows the partnership capability to scale.

• Build and develop a senior, globally effective organization over time.

 Why the Role Matters

 The company’s advantage depends on connecting high-quality data, identity, and signals with the platforms, data environments, and AI ecosystems where customers already work.

 These partnerships are viewed as a company-level lever for product innovation, differentiation, distribution, and growth, rather than simply a source of partner-sourced revenue.

 The successful leader will have significant influence over product direction, ecosystem positioning, investment choices, and how the company creates long-term strategic advantage.

 What Success Looks Like

 In the first 60 days

• Assess the existing portfolio, market landscape, strategic gaps, team capabilities, active commitments, and role boundaries.

 By 90 days

• Develop an executive-ready technology, data, and AI ecosystem strategy with a concentrated set of priority bets, investment choices, executive sponsors, and Product and R&D commitments.

 Within six months

• Demonstrate visible progress on consequential partnerships, including signed or late-stage agreements with funded productization paths and clear measures of impact.

 Within 12 months

• Establish a focused portfolio producing measurable adoption, distribution, differentiation, and commercial impact, supported by trusted C-suite relationships and a scalable team and operating model.

 The Profile That Will Be Successful

• An executive who has built or materially scaled a technology, platform, product, or data partnership capability.

• Someone who combines ecosystem strategy with enough technical fluency to engage credibly on architecture, APIs, data rights, identity, security, privacy, and AI.

• A sophisticated negotiator who understands partnership structures, economics, data licensing, commercialization, and joint product delivery.

• A strong cross-functional leader who can align senior Product, Engineering, commercial, legal, finance, and executive stakeholders around difficult investment and roadmap choices.

• Someone with a practical understanding of how AI, agents, and MCP are changing enterprise software ecosystems.

• A builder who can create the strategy, operating model, governance, metrics, and leadership team required for the capability to scale.

Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. In addition, 6sense provides a variety of benefits, including generous health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, self-care days, and paid time off (PTO).

title: Compliance Manager, Card
description:
Headquarters: Remote Canada

 At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

 About the Legal, Compliance, and Public Affairs team

 The Legal, Compliance, and Public Affairs team is a group of dedicated professionals committed to helping Affirm scale, innovate, and provide outstanding products for consumers, merchants, and key partners. We combine legal, compliance, and policy expertise to guide growth, shape products, and build trust across our ecosystem. Our work spans multiple professional disciplines and provides the foundation for Affirm’s mission to deliver honest financial products.

 About the role

 Affirm is seeking a Compliance Manager to own compliance advisory for the Affirm Card program. You'll make independent, risk-based calls across card marketing, onboarding, disputes, and remediation, partnering with Product, Engineering, and Operations to ship card features that are compliant and built to last.

 What you'll do

•
 Own end-to-end compliance advisory for the Affirm Card program, including card marketing, checkout, onboarding, wallets (Apple Pay, Google Pay), disputes, and servicing, partnering directly with Product, Engineering, and Operations throughout the development lifecycle

•
 Bring an appetite for the unknown: much of what we build on Card is genuinely new and without precedent, and you take on that ambiguity rather than wait for a playbook

•
 Apply sound judgment under EFTA (Reg E), TILA (Reg Z)/CARD Act, UDAAP, to navigate novel regulatory questions, escalating only where it's genuinely warranted

•
 Review and approve Affirm Card marketing, disclosures, and UX to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and consistency with consumer protection standards

•
 Lead root-cause analysis and remediation for Card compliance issues (e.g., disputes, adverse action notices, declines) through to sustainable closure, prioritizing durable fixes over one-off patches so issues don't recur

•
 Partner with Compliance Testing, Legal, and Risk to prepare for and support regulatory exams and bank partner audits related to the Card program

•
 Maintain and contribute to the Card program's compliance risk assessment and control inventory, proactively identifying and closing coverage gaps

•
 Develop and maintain compliance training and reference materials specific to Card regulatory requirements

•
 Serve as the go-to compliance expert on new and evolving Card features, surfacing risk early in the product lifecycle rather than after launch

 What we look for

•
 8+ years of experience in a compliance advisory role within financial services with a Bachelor's degree (6+ years with a Master's degree, or 3+ years with a PhD, or equivalent), with meaningful experience on card, payments; compliance certifications a plus

•
 Deep working knowledge of EFTA (Reg E) and TILA (Reg Z)/CARD Act as applied to card products, plus familiarity with TISA (Reg DD) and UDAAP; hands-on experience with card network rules (e.g., Visa, Mastercard) is a big plus

•
 A demonstrated track record of operating independently in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, making sound, risk-based decisions with incomplete information and escalating only when it truly requires it

•
 Comfortable partnering closely with Product from the early stages of a build, whether a new product, feature, or servicing program, in fast-paced, ambiguous environments

•
 Experience owning issues from root-cause analysis through sustainable remediation, with a bias toward fixing the underlying control rather than the immediate symptom

•
 Experience advising and building credibility with Product, Engineering, and Operations stakeholders on a card, lending, or payments program

•
 Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly present complex, nuanced regulatory issues to non-compliance audiences

•
 Self-directed with strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills; comfortable being the compliance voice in the room on card-specific questions, including presenting to senior leadership and leadership committees

•
 Inquisitive and proactive in identifying problems and proposing practical, business-aware solutions

 Base Pay Grade - L

 Equity Grade - 5

 Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

CAN base pay range per year: $128,000 - $188,000

 #LI-Remote

 Remote-first with flexibility built in
 Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

 Benefits designed for you
 Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

• Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.

• Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.

• Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.

• Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

 We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

 For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

 By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

 Our People:

 People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

 The Role

 As the new Director, Revenue Accounting , you will l ead and own the end-to-end Revenue Accounting function, ensuring accurate and timely revenue recognition, financial reporting, and compliance with ASC 606. You s erve as the primary Accounting partner to Sales, Deal Desk, Revenue Operations, and Product on complex customer arrangements, contract structuring, and revenue-related business decisions. If you dream of driving operational excellence, creating scalable processes, strong internal controls, and systems automation to support business growth, this is the opportunity for you!

 Responsibilities & Accountabilities

 The Director, Revenue Accounting will oversee all aspects of revenue accounting, including monthly and quarterly close, technical revenue accounting, contract reviews, revenue reporting, audit support, and related internal controls.

 The role requires a hands-on leader capable of managing day-to-day execution while driving strategic initiatives across revenue systems, deal structuring, automation, and process improvements.

 You will work cross-functionally with Sales, Deal Desk, Revenue Operations, FP&A, Product, and IT to ensure revenue arrangements are appropriately structured, recorded, and reported.

 Revenue Accounting & Financial Close

• Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue close, including revenue journal entries, reconciliations, and financial statement accuracy.

• Oversee revenue recognition, deferred revenue, RPO, contract modifications, and revenue allocation under ASC 606.

• Review revenue flux analyses, account reconciliations, and key revenue-related accounting judgments.

• Ensure timely and accurate revenue reporting to Finance leadership and support management and Board reporting.

• Oversee revenue-related reserves, adjustments, and other nonstandard accounting matters.

 Contract Review & Technical Accounting

• Serve as the primary accounting reviewer for customer contracts, renewals, upsells, and nonstandard commercial arrangements.

• Evaluate complex contract provisions, assess ASC 606 implications and document technical accounting conclusions for significant or unusual transactions.

• Partner with Sales, Deal Desk, and Legal to proactively identify and resolve accounting and commercial risks.

• Maintain revenue recognition policies, contract review guidelines, and approval controls.

 Revenue Systems, Automation & Process Improvement

• Partner with Revenue Operations, Product, and IT on CPQ, SKU architecture, pricing and packaging, and revenue systems enhancements.

• Oversee revenue-related system requirements, including standalone selling price (SSP) allocation, contract data, entitlements, and integration with Sage Intacct.

• Drive automation of revenue close, reconciliations, reporting, and contract review processes.

• Establish scalable processes and controls supporting new products, usage-based pricing, and evolving business models.

• Lead Finance participation in user acceptance testing and implementation of revenue-related system changes.

 Audit, Compliance & Internal Controls

• Serve as the primary Revenue Accounting contact for external auditors.

• Prepare and review revenue accounting schedules, technical memos, and supporting audit documentation.

• Maintain effective revenue-related internal controls, including deal approval, revenue recognition, and reporting processes.

• Identify control gaps and implement improvements to strengthen financial reporting accuracy and operational efficiency.

 Cross-Functional Partnership & Team Leadership

• Lead, mentor, and develop the Revenue Accounting team, ensuring appropriate coverage, accountability, and knowledge transfer.

• Partner closely with FP&A on revenue forecasts, bookings, RPO, and management reporting.

• Collaborate with Sales, Deal Desk, and Revenue Operations to balance commercial flexibility with sound accounting and financial controls.

• Provide technical guidance and training to business partners on revenue recognition requirements and deal structuring.

 Competencies and Behaviors

• Technical expertise: Strong command of US GAAP and ASC 606, with sound judgment on complex accounting matters.

• Ownership and accountability: Takes end-to-end responsibility for deliverables, decisions, and issue resolution.

• Hands-on leadership: Comfortable operating at both strategic and detailed execution levels.

• Business partnership: Commercially minded and able to work effectively with Sales and other functions while maintaining appropriate financial controls.

• Analytical and problem-solving skills: Able to identify risks, challenge assumptions, and develop practical solutions.

• Systems and process orientation: Proactive in driving automation, operational scalability, and continuous improvement.

• Communication and influence: Able to clearly communicate complex accounting matters to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

• People leadership: Develops talent, builds team capability, and fosters accountability and collaboration.

• Adaptability: Thrives in a fast-paced environment with evolving products, systems, and business requirements.

 Educational and Experience Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance; CPA required or strongly preferred.

• 12+ years of progressive accounting experience, including significant revenue recognition and technical accounting responsibilities.

• 5+ years of experience in SaaS, enterprise software, or technology companies.

• Strong working knowledge of ASC 606, including multiple performance obligations, SSP allocation, contract modifications, and usage-based arrangements.

• Experience leading revenue close processes, managing teams, and supporting external audits.

• Experience with Salesforce, CPQ systems, and ERP/revenue accounting systems; Sage Intacct experience preferred.

• Demonstrated success in revenue process automation, systems implementations, and cross-functional initiatives.

• Public accounting or Big Four experience preferred.
