Do you thrive on a relentless pursuit of new business and come equipped with a network of relationships that can be leveraged immediately? Justworks is looking for a Senior Account Executive who isn't just looking for a job - they're looking to hit the ground running and make an immediate impact. This role is for a seasoned professional who understands the modern SaaS sales cycle and has a deep, innate knowledge of the PEO space, likely coming from a competitor. This isn't a ramp-up role; this is a "slide in and close" opportunity.

 Your Mission

 Your primary mission is to expand our user base and drive significant growth. You'll be the face of Justworks, building trust with business owners and evangelizing our product suite in the small business world. Your success is measured by your ability to manage your own book of business, build and manage a complete end-to-end sales pipeline, and consistently exceed your quotas.

 What You Will Work On

• Own the Pipeline: From prospecting to close, you'll manage all activities required to win.

• Hunt for New Business: Proactively prospect for new business through market research, sales tools, and cold outreach.

• Leverage Your Network: Build and nurture relationships with channel partners, especially brokers. We're looking for someone who can leverage a pre-existing rolodex of relationships to generate leads in addition to traditional cold methods.

• Be a PEO Expert: You will be an ambassador for Justworks and its solutions, gaining an intimate and comprehensive knowledge of our product suite to effectively communicate its value proposition to potential customers.

• Advocate for the Customer: Be the voice of our future customers, suggesting innovative ideas to improve the customer experience and advocating for product development internally.

• Expand Your Territory: Research and establish a dominant presence in your assigned territory, developing a strategic plan to connect with the entrepreneurial community.

 How You Will Do Your Work

 As a Senior Account Executive, how results are achieved is paramount for your success and ultimately result in our success as an organization. In this role, your foundational knowledge, skills, abilities, and personal attributes are anchored in the following competencies:

• Good judgement - the exercise of critical thinking, analyzing and assessing problems and implications, identifying patterns, making connections of underlying issues, understanding risks and developing mitigation strategies, and taking ownership of the outcome.

• Detail-oriented - exercises extreme attention to detail; is thorough, accurate, organized, and productive and seeks to understand both the cause and effect of a situation.

• Foundational sales knowledge - the specific set of sales skills (prospecting, cold calling, nurturing, engaging, presenting, negotiating, closing etc) and knowledge (product, markets, trends, business etc) a salesperson possesses to enact the exchange of value between a buyer and the vendor.

• Results-driven - consistently achieves results, even under difficult circumstances.

• Clear communication - the ability to articulate thoughts and express ideas effectively using oral, written, visual and non-verbal communication skills, as well as listening skills to gain understanding.

 In addition, all Justworkers focus on aligning their behaviors to our core values known as COGIS. It stands for:

• Camaraderie - Day to day you can be seen working together toward a higher purpose. You like to have fun. You’re an active listener, treat people respectfully, and have a strong desire to know and help others.

• Openness - Your default is to be open. You're willing to share information, understand other perspectives, and consider new possibilities. You’re curious, ask open questions, and are receptive to thoughts and feedback from others.

• Grit - You demonstrate grit by having the courage to commit and persevere. You’re committed, earnest, and dive in to get the job done well with a positive attitude.

• Integrity - Simply put, do what you say and say what you'll do. You’re honest and forthright, have a strong moral compass, and strive to match your words with your actions while leading by example.

• Simplicity - Be like Einstein: “Everything should be made as simple as possible, but no simpler.”

 Qualifications

• A minimum of 5 years experience in an Account Executive position managing a complete and consultative sales cycle and closing is required. Experience in Lead generation for B2B in a high-velocity setting (i.e., SaaS, PEO, Fintech). Salesforce, SalesLoft, LinkedIn SalesNavigator, and/or ZoomInfo are required. Experience with Outreach.io and/or Hubspot, in addition to 6Sense and/or Hoovers/D&B, is a plus.

• Cold-calling experience is required for this position.

• We are seeking candidates with a hunter mentality who are dedicated to grabbing new prospects, netting new logos, closing deals, and delivering immediate results.

• Have established ecosystem relationships with Broker & Accountant Channel partners.

• Passionate about sales and relationship-focused customer engagements

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, and demonstrates the ability to listen to gather important information during a sales call and/or meeting

• Ability to simplify complicated topics and explain them in terms people can easily understand

• Able to apply creative solutions to a variety of issues in a fast-paced environment

• You enjoy entrepreneurial environments and the opportunity to build something meaningful!

• There is occasional travel in some territories (25% travel), which includes networking events, trade shows, and meeting potential clients in your area(s).

title: International Payroll Analyst
description:
Headquarters: Remote - United Kingdom

 Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

 Reddit is seeking an experienced, highly analytical International Payroll Analyst to own and scale our international payroll operations across LATAM, EMEA, and APAC regions. As a key individual contributor with deep cross-functional influence, you will combine data-driven execution, meticulous attention to detail, and international tax compliance to support a rapidly growing workforce. Reporting to the Sr. Global Payroll Manager, this role will help to drive major strategic initiatives—including Workday enhancements and global payroll vendor implementations—to build scalable, best-in-class operational processes. The role partners closely with Payroll Vendors and internal teams across People, Finance, Tax, Legal, Treasury, Equity, and Internal Audit to deliver accurate, timely, compliant, and employee-centered payroll outcomes.

 What You’ll Do:

• International Payroll Execution & Oversight:

• Manage, audit, and execute multi-country payroll delivery across 15+ international countries, including payroll inputs, validation, approvals, funding coordination, reconciliations, statutory filings, and post-payroll activities ensure high accuracy and strict adherence to strict regional pay schedules.

• Lead the payroll calendar and operating cadence across countries, proactively managing dependencies, cutoffs, exceptions, and risks to ensure employees are paid accurately and on time.

• Partner with local in-country payroll providers to maintain strict adherence to regional pay schedules and statutory processing windows.

• Compliance & Equity Management: Oversee international equity compensation payroll processing (RSUs, Stock Options) and ensure full regulatory compliance across international tax jurisdictions, localized statutory benefits, and reporting requirements.

• Systems & Scaling Initiatives: Act as functional lead for payroll technology projects, leveraging Workday to automate workflows, optimize system configurations, build custom reporting, and partner with the Sr. Global payroll Manager to implement upcoming enterprise Global Payroll solutions.

• Cross-Functional & Vendor Management: Partner with Benefits, People Operations, Legal, and Finance; manage external vendor relationships and third-party tax fulfillment partners to ensure seamless funds reconciliation and local tax compliance.

• Process Controls: Establish, document, and enforce global payroll policies, SOX controls, and standard operating procedures to streamline audit readiness (401k, Workers’ Comp, Financial Audits).

• Strategic Growth Projects: Support special business initiatives, including M&A integrations, new country market entries, and business-critical cross-functional launches.

 What We’re Looking For:

• Experience: 5+ years of progressive payroll operations experience in a high-growth, publicly traded tech company with a global footprint.

• Education : Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in payroll, accounting, finance, human resources, or a related field.

• Systems Expertise: Proficiency with Workday Payroll (reporting, configuration, integrations) and global payroll software platforms.

• Technical & Analytical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets (vlookups, index/match, pivot tables) for complex data analysis, reconciliation, and audit modeling.

• Domain Expertise: Thorough understanding of global equity taxation, statutory compliance, international labor laws, and multi-currency payroll distribution.

• Execution & Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving capabilities, high discretion handling confidential data, and exceptional communication skills to collaborate seamlessly across teams.

 Bonus Points

• Responding to internal, external, statutory, and financial audit requests, including preparation of reconciliations, control evidence, and supporting documentation.

• Applying automation or AI tools to payroll operations, analytics, controls, case management, or knowledge documentation.

• Providing high-quality customer service to employees and business partners across regions, cultures, and time zones.

• Working in a publicly traded, technology, or high-growth company and supporting international expansion or payroll transformation.

 How Success Will Be Measured

• Operational Excellence: Accurate, timely, and compliant payroll delivery across the international footprint.

• Audit & Governance: Strong controls, clean reconciliations, and audit-ready documentation.

• Vendor Management: Reliable vendor performance and effective resolution of payroll issues.

• Scalability: Scalable processes, improved automation, and clear country-level operating documentation.

• Stakeholder Satisfaction: Trusted partnerships and a responsive, employee-centered service experience.

title: Regional Vice President, Enterprise Account Management
description:
Headquarters: United States, Remote

 Job Title: Regional Vice President, Enterprise Account Management

 Location: United States, Remote

 This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.

 ABOUT THE COMPANY:

 Revenue is complex, and clarity is rare. Our mission at Salesloft is to transform revenue complexity into clear, decisive action for every team driving growth.

 We’re building the industry’s first Predictive Revenue System, where humans and AI work together to make confident decisions based on real signals. Thousands of customers run on our platforms every day, which gives us Revenue Context: a view into what happens in a deal, when, and with what outcome.

 Our vision is a future where revenue growth is predictable and the teams driving it are unstoppable. If you want to help build it, alongside people who Move as One and let Evidence over Ego guide the work, we’d love to meet you.

 THE OPPORTUNITY
 Lead one of our highest-performing enterprise teams as it shows customers why a Predictive Revenue System is the way to run pipeline, forecast and growth.

 As our Regional Vice President, Enterprise Account Management, you’ll lead 6 to 8 seasoned enterprise sellers who own our largest customer relationships. At Salesloft, we connect pipeline generation, deal progression and forecasting in one closed loop through our Predictive Revenue System, and you’ll help your team bring that story to senior revenue and technology leaders. In your first six months you will:

• Keep a strong team on the field: assess the talent, decide where to upskill and where to add, and keep the team’s momentum through a rapidly changing market.

• Shift the conversations your team has: engage the executives who own the revenue problem and the leaders who own the AI and go-to-market strategy, and sharpen how we win against build-it-yourself and frontier-model alternatives.

• Grow the base: lift win rates and velocity on six- and seven-figure expansion opportunities, and open more cross-sell conversations with customers who don’t yet use us for their entire revenue lifecycle process.

 HOW YOU’LL WORK HERE

• Move as One: You’ll work daily with SEs, Customer Success, RevOps, Product and Marketing, and share credit for the wins. Our sellers own the renewal and the growth, so you’ll help them mobilize the whole company behind each customer.

• Evidence over Ego: You’ll inspect pipeline and forecast using real buyer signals, not gut feel, and say so when the data changes your mind.

• Lead from the Front: You’ll coach in the work, stay close to key deals without taking them over, and take ownership early, with or without a title that says you should.

• Make Your Mark: You’ll shape how we sell the Predictive Revenue System to enterprise buyers, not just run the existing playbook.

• Customer-Inspired: You’ll turn what customers tell you into what we build and say, including why they choose to build, buy or consolidate.

 WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
 You’re a sales leader who makes experienced sellers better, builds trust with executives, and stays close to the business without taking it over. You’re as comfortable inspecting a forecast as you are coaching a hard conversation. If you want to learn more, do more, and become more, this is your next move.

 YOU’LL BRING

• A record of leading enterprise teams to results: Consistent quota attainment across 5+ years of leading enterprise sellers, with a team where several reps reach top-performer status.

• Hands-on leadership of complex deals: You’ve guided large, multi-stakeholder deals (six to seven figures) through renewal and expansion, and know how to add value in the room without taking over from the rep.

• Coaching that changes behavior and raises the bar: You coach to specific, observable selling behaviors (discovery, value articulation, deal strategy, executive conversations) and to MEDDPICC discipline in deal qualification and inspection. You do this through call reviews, role-play and regular 1:1s, and you hold sellers accountable for the change. You see results in win rates, deal velocity and pipeline quality, and you hire coachable sellers who raise the bar for the team.

• A forecast leaders can trust: You inspect pipeline using buyer evidence, stage discipline and conversion data, and you can explain what drove a miss.

• Executive and cross-functional presence: You can build a business case with a CRO or CFO and align SEs, Customer Success, RevOps and Product behind a customer.

• Comfort leading through change: You’ve kept a team focused and performing through shifts in product, comp, territory or market.

 IT’S A BONUS IF YOU HAVE

• Experience selling revenue technology (sales engagement, conversation intelligence, forecasting or revenue operations) to CROs, RevOps and Sales Enablement leaders

• Experience leading sellers through a combined renewal and growth motion, not new business alone

• Fluency with AI tools and workflows, and experience selling to the leaders who own AI strategy and the build-versus-buy decision

• Experience competing against internally built tools or displacing incumbents in enterprise accounts

 THE TEAM
 You’ll lead 6 to 8 seasoned enterprise sellers on one of the strongest teams in our enterprise segment, with several already at or pacing toward President’s Club. The team owns both retention and growth across our largest customers, at a time when Salesloft is changing how we sell and who we sell to. It’s a great place to grow: you’ll have a high-performing team, real influence on how we go to market, and the backing of leadership and enablement to do it well.

 BENEFITS:

 Your well-being matters to us. We offer a competitive, holistic benefits program designed to support your physical, mental, and financial health at every stage of your life and career. For full details on coverage options, wellness incentives, and perks, explore our benefits overview at https://salesloftbenefits.com/

 At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.

 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

 If you’re excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!

description:
Headquarters: Remote - United Kingdom

 Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

 Working as a Growth Manager supporting Reddit’s International Community team, you will develop and execute initiatives that strengthen Reddit’s user and community ecosystems in the US and across international markets.

 This position is open to candidates based in the UK or the US - East Coast.

 This is not a marketing role. You will identify high-impact growth opportunities, design and execute experiments, and develop successful interventions into repeatable models that can be applied across markets. Your work may include building and scaling communities, increasing the supply of relevant content and contributions, reaching underserved audiences, and strengthening Reddit’s user experience.

 The role combines growth strategy, hands-on experimentation, data analysis, and cross-functional influence. You will work closely with Product, Data Science, Marketing, and Community teams while maintaining the autonomy and entrepreneurial mindset required to scale successful initiatives to other markets.

 Responsibilities:

• User & Community Growth Strategies: Establish and execute comprehensive strategies to grow the user base and nurture communities.

• Growth Experimentation: Design and execute growth experiments aimed at addressing gaps in content supply, community density, contribution, discovery, engagement, and user growth. Apply a creative, entrepreneurial approach by testing ideas quickly, learning from results, and iterating accordingly.

• Scaling and Repeatability: Translate successful experiments into repeatable playbooks, processes, and recommendations that can be applied across markets. Determine which elements can scale broadly, which require local adaptation, and what operational or product support is needed to unlock broader impact.

• Data & Performance Analytics: Monitor key growth and ecosystem indicators, including DAU, contribution, content supply, community health, and retention. Analyze performance trends, identify risks and opportunities, and establish clear measurement frameworks for experiments and scaled programs.

• Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with various internal teams to provide insights, shape priorities, and scale growth initiatives. Build compelling evidence through experimentation to influence cross-functional investment and product development.

 Required Qualifications:

•

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 5+ years of experience in user growth, product operations, or market expansion, with a demonstrated track record of executing growth initiatives at scale.

• Strong entrepreneurial instincts, hands-on execution skills, and the ability to make progress independently in ambiguous or resource-constrained environments.

• Data-driven and analytical mindset, with proficiency in Excel modeling, working knowledge of SQL, and experience creating scalable processes and automations.

• Strong systems thinking, with the ability to distinguish between market-specific problems and growth opportunities that can be addressed through repeatable approaches.

• Exceptional communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively and align cross-functional stakeholders across global teams.

• Results-oriented mindset, strong attention to detail, and a bias toward execution.

• Comfort balancing a portfolio of opportunities across the US and international markets and prioritizing based on potential impact, feasibility, and strategic relevance.

title: Principal Partner Solutions Architect (GSI)
description:
Headquarters: Remote, New York, United States, AMER

 From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

 About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

 About the Role

 We’re looking for a Principal Partner Solutions Architect (GSI) to be Fivetran + dbt Labs' global technical advisor to our priority Global Systems Integrators (GSIs) — comfortable operating at executive level, leading the conversation, and directing execution of the joint business plan by combining technical depth with business insight. You are the ecosystem peer to the GSI's lead architects and delivery leads. You will own the technical capability, overarching solution architecture, and multi-year bets of the GSI partnership you support.

 This role partners closely with the global alliance leads for these GSIs to articulate the true total value of each technical solution and execute impactful engagements across regions and countries. Functionally, the role sits at the intersection of field engineering, product management, and partnerships. Your closest counterparts are the GSI's practice and delivery leadership, the regional Partner Solutions Architects and Partnerships teams who run the day-to-day motion, and product managers across both Fivetran and dbt Labs. Operating at the Principal level, you will report directly to the Global Head of Partner Solutions Architecture.

 This is a full-time position based in the US.

 What You’ll Do

• Build a trusted advisory relationship with priority GSIs and engage with their senior technical stakeholders and practice leads to secure multi-year technology bets with Fivetran and dbt Labs.

• Own the joint technical narrative and capability messaging for the combined Fivetran + dbt Labs platform as it applies to this GSI's delivery practice — reference architectures, integration patterns, and the joint value story their consultants use with mutual customers.

• Provide domain expertise around modern data platforms and enterprise technology, and effectively promote Fivetran + dbt Labs with partners, at conferences, and online.

• Make recommendations on integration strategies, partner-side enterprise architectures, platforms, and application infrastructure required to successfully implement complete solutions for complex GSI mega-agreements.

• Maintain a single, current view of integration state, gaps, and opportunities across the combined platform (ingestion, transformation, semantic layer, catalog/metadata, agent and MCP interfaces) as it affects this GSI's delivery methodology, and collaborate with Product to drive the right outcomes.

• Co-develop intellectual property with GSI partners — enterprise-grade, replicable joint solutions and accelerators built with product management and technical teams — and evangelize that IP with partners, customers, and the field to drive adoption.

• Run the standing technical cadence with the GSI's practice and delivery leadership as their primary technical counterpart.

• Drive and influence GSI audiences, identify expansion engagements within partner accounts, and ensure accelerated agreement velocity with zero partner-delivery escalations on GSI-led mega-agreements.

• Partner with the regional Partner Solutions Architects and Partnerships organization so the global GSI relationship turns into regional execution, and so they can run the motion without you in the room.

• Travel to partner and customer sites, conferences, and other related events as needed.

 Skills We’re Looking For

• Direct experience with technology and/or systems integrator alliances, or having sat on the delivery/practice side of a GSI or similar consulting organization — with a track record of shaping and scalingtechnical partner GTM.

• 10+ years of experience as an enterprise/solutions architect or in an equivalent customer- and partner-facing role.

• Fluency across the modern data stack (ingestion, transformation, orchestration, warehouses/lakehouses, semantic layers, catalogs, BI, and the agent/MCP layer) and the ability to explain how the pieces fit for a systems integrator's delivery practice.

• A demonstrable understanding of how GSIs operate, build, deploy and monetise Intellectual Property with technology partners.

• Experience engaging with, and presenting to, senior technical stakeholders and executive leaders, with the business acumen to translate technical solutions into partner and customer value.

• Experience with modern AI paradigms, generative AI, and data technologies, including experience evaluating and reviewing technical solutions.

• Ability to drive and influence GSI audiences, identify expansion engagements within partner accounts, and ensure accelerated agreement velocity with zero partner-delivery escalations on GSI-led mega-agreements.

• Ability to deliver results and work cross-functionally to position and orchestrate joint solutions spanning multiple products

 Bonus Skills​

• Verticalized knowledge of data and analytics technology solutions, with the ability to learn and work with new and emerging tools, methodologies, and platforms.

• Experience with structured enterprise architecture practices, hybrid deployments, and on-premise-to-cloud migration roadmaps.

• Ability to influence product roadmap: gathering requirements from a partner, building a prioritization case, and getting it accepted by product leadership.

• Hands-on experience with dbt and with Fivetran.

 Compensation & Benefits

 Perks and Benefits

You will play a significant role in the expansion of growth within these accounts. You should be business oriented, customer focused, and a self-starter who works well with little supervision.

 Responsibilities:

title: Engineering Manager - Grafana Infrastructure | USA | Remote
description:
Headquarters: United States (Remote)

 Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X .

 We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

 You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

 This is a remote position and we're considering candidates in the US or Canada (residents of Québec are not eligible for this position).

 The Opportunity

 About our platform

 Grafana Cloud moves millions of metrics, log lines, and traces per second from our customers' environments into a highly available, low-latency stack that processes and stores this data, and serves it to dashboards and alerting tools. We aim to grow this to hundreds of millions per second, and it's critical that as we grow, we improve our performance, increase our reliability, and do it efficiently and securely.

 The Foundations department owns the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP): the Kubernetes clusters, cloud service provider resources (CSP), hardware, identity, delivery, and observability systems that Grafana Labs's application engineers use to build, deploy, and run their workloads.

 About the Infrastructure group

 We're hiring an engineering manager for the Foundations Infrastructure group, which owns the cloud infrastructure Grafana Cloud runs on. The group provisions and operates Kubernetes clusters and CSP resources across GCP, AWS, and Azure; enforces identity, access, and security controls across those environments; and runs the observability and cost-visibility systems that keep the infrastructure measurable and accountable.

 You'll lead one of the squads of platform engineers that comprise the group.

 We're platform engineers, and our application teams are our users. Our job is to give them leverage: self-service building blocks that take care of the hard parts of infrastructure, so they can focus on what they're building. We treat the platform as a product and value the experience of the people who use it. When a change is well communicated and understood, teams welcome it, and it lands as an improvement that makes the right way the easy way. You'll lead a squad that makes that happen.

 How we work

 Foundations is a global team that works asynchronously. The people who own a component or problem make the decisions about it, once stakeholders have had a chance to weigh in. Application teams build and run their own services; we give them a self-service platform to do it on.

 Every engineer is on-call for the components their squad provides. We plan on-call, tactical work, and time off into every quarter, so roadmap work is roughly half of an engineer's time rather than all of it.

 What You'll Be Doing

• Hire, manage, and develop a squad of platform engineers, with regular feedback and career conversations that support each person's growth.

• Own your squad's roadmap and quarterly objectives: help decide what the squad works on, what it defers, and why, across a broad remit where demand always exceeds capacity.

• Take platform changes from design to fleet-wide adoption: staged rollouts, migration paths, and clear communication, so changes land well for the teams who depend on them.

• Partner with the other Infrastructure squads on work that spans them, and with the teams across Foundations and the rest of Engineering whose work depends on yours.

• Help shape how the group works as a whole, including planning, on-call, and the ownership model between squads.

title: GTM AI Engineer
description:

 About the Job:

 LaunchDarkly helps engineering teams ship software faster and more safely through feature management, experimentation, and AI delivery tooling. As a GTM AI Engineer, you will design, build, and operate the AI-powered systems that make our sales, marketing, customer success, and partnerships teams more effective.

 You will sit at the intersection of engineering and revenue. You’ll turn messy go-to-market workflows into reliable, measurable automation, such as agents that research accounts, tools that surface buying signals, and pipelines that keep our data trustworthy. You’ll work directly with GTM stakeholders to find high-leverage problems, ship quickly, and prove impact with data.

 Responsibilities:

• Design and build LLM-powered agents and workflows for use cases like account research, lead and account prioritization, outbound personalization, call summarization, deal inspection, renewal risk detection, and customer health insights.

• Focus on end user experience to optimize delivery of content, process adherence and tool utilization

• Integrate AI systems with the GTM stack (Salesforce, Outreach, Gong, Marketo, Slack, Zoom, data warehouse, and enrichment providers).

• Build and maintain data pipelines that unify product usage, CRM, marketing, and support data into reliable inputs for models and agents.

• Partner with Sales, Marketing, CS, and RevOps leaders to translate business problems into technical solutions, and prioritize by revenue impact and effort.

• Establish evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and monitoring for AI outputs, covering accuracy, hallucination rates, cost, latency, and adoption.

• Use LaunchDarkly’s own products, such as feature flags, AI Configs, and experimentation, to roll out, test, and iterate on GTM AI systems safely.

• Prototype quickly, then productionize the winners with solid engineering practices (testing, observability, documentation, access controls).

• Enable GTM teams through training, documentation, and playbooks so AI tools are adopted and trusted.

• Stay current on the AI tooling landscape and recommend build vs. buy decisions.

 Qualifications:

• 4+ years of software engineering, data engineering, or ML/AI engineering experience (or equivalent hands-on experience)

• Strong proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript, plus SQL

• Hands-on experience building applications with LLMs (prompt design, tool use/function calling, RAG, agent frameworks, structured outputs)

• Experience integrating with REST/GraphQL APIs and SaaS platforms, ideally CRM and sales engagement tools

• Familiarity with data warehouses and transformation tools (Snowflake, BigQuery, dbt, or similar)

• Ability to evaluate and monitor AI system quality using test sets, human review, and automated evals

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders

• A bias toward shipping, iterating, and measuring outcomes

 Databricks is seeking a Lakebase Sales Specialist to help customers modernise their operational data foundation with Databricks Lakebase , our fully-managed Postgres offering for intelligent applications .  Lakebase gives customers a unified, governed foundation for operational workloads and AI-native applications , helping them move away from a fragmented estate of point databases toward a modern, scalable, serverless Postgres service. If you want to be at the forefront of operational databases for AI and intelligent applications at one of the fastest-growing data and AI companies in the world, this is your opportunity.

 The impact you will have:

• Drive new Lakebase revenue by identifying, qualifying, and driving Lakebase activations and consumption within a defined territory, in partnership with regional Account Executives and the broader account team

• Lead with outcomes for key Lakebase personas, including platform teams and developers , data teams , and central IT, articulating how Lakebase helps them ship features faster, simplify operational data architectures, and improve governance and cost efficiency

• Sell the value of fully-managed Postgres for intelligent applications , positioning Lakebase as the optimal choice for operational workloads that power real-time, AI-driven experiences

• Run complex sales cycles from discovery and value hypothesis through commercial negotiation and close, navigating executive, technical, and line-of-business stakeholders

• Orchestrate proof-of-value and POCs that validate Lakebase’s benefits for OLTP-style workloads, reverse ETL, and AI/ML-driven applications, in partnership with solution architects and specialists

• Compete and win against legacy and cloud-native operational databases by leveraging our compete assets, benchmarks, and customer references

• Establish top strategic focus accounts by engaging application development teams to create net-new intelligent applications leveraging Lakebase

 Success in this role requires strength in four areas:

• Business ownership: Operate at a business-unit level by tracking revenue, pipeline, and key observations, and by identifying areas needing additional focus or support.

• Market voice and thought leadership: Develop an internal and external presence, and by representing Databricks at key first- and third-party events.

 The interview process is designed to evaluate candidates across all four of these dimensions.

• Relevant enterprise sales experience , consistently exceeding quota in complex, multi-stakeholder deals

• Ability to sell to both technical stakeholders (developers, architects, data engineers) and business stakeholders (product leaders, operations, line-of-business owners)

• Executive presence with the ability to whiteboard architectures , lead C-level conversations, and build trust with senior decision makers

• Strong value selling skills: adept at discovering pain, building a business case, and tying technical capabilities to clear, quantified outcomes

title: Compliance Trust Analyst
description:
Headquarters: Remote - USA

 About the Role

 Abnormal AI is looking for a Trust Analyst II to join the Compliance Trust team within Abnormal’s Trust organization. The Trust organization is made up of the Compliance Trust and Customer Trust teams. This role sits on the Compliance Trust team, which owns the company’s GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) programs. The Compliance Trust team drives internal and external audit readiness, manages enterprise and third-party risk, and leads governance across information security, AI, and data to deliver a foundation to maintain company's information security, privacy, and AI compliance certifications...

 This role owns Abnormal's governance and policy program, chairing and running the company's governance committees, including AI Governance, Data Governance, Security Governance, and other governance programs as they are implemented. Additionally this role will hold end-to-end ownership of policy management, from drafting through stakeholder acknowledgment and management of the company’s Policy Center. Governance and policy ownership make up the majority of this role's scope. The remainder of the role will be a key stakeholder in risk management operations, including managing the risk register, performing risk assessments, and risk exception administration. Lastly, this role will also include general compliance support such as audit readiness, control evaluation, and issue remediation.

 The ideal candidate will have the mindset of an auditor with keen attention to detail, possess exceptional skills in project management, be a good communicator who excels at explaining complex technology to diverse audiences in a way that fosters understanding and ownership, has strong collaboration and business sense, and an adept awareness of our customers' requirements of Abnormal as a leading cybersecurity SaaS provider.

 Who You Are

• Proven security experience in an audit or advisory capacity

• Analytical thinker who exercises good business judgment and resolves ambiguous or judgment call questions without direction

• Resolves multi-framework or complex audit questions where the path isn't obvious, and designs an approach when standard procedure falls short and brings a recommendation to the table, not just a problem, and knows when to loop in Legal or Security to get it right

• Confidence and willingness to ask questions, raise issues, and concerns in a timely manner

• Comfortable owning and running cross-functional governance committees (e.g., AI Governance, Data Governance, Security Governance), setting agendas, driving decisions, and following through on action items without needing to be chased

• Experienced managing a policy program end to end. Authoring, revising, and defending policy positions to stakeholders, not just administering logistics

• High attention to detail, process, and organization with strong project management skills to ensure accountability and results

• Acts as a trusted partner to other Abnormal teams and external auditors on their domain, leading structured discussions grounded in evidence rather than assumption, and represents the function credibly in auditor-facing settings

• Comfortable interpreting requirements in business context rather than taking a control requirement at face value, and anticipating how upstream changes affect compliance posture

• Ability to adapt to change, including evolving business and technical environments, and manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment

• Team player, collaborative work style

• Self-motivated and able to work efficiently with minimal oversight/direction

• Owns outcomes rather than activity — accountable for a compliance domain end to end, including audit outcomes and remediation tracking

 What You Will Do

• Own and run Abnormal's governance committees including AI Governance, Data Governance, Security Governance, and any additional governance programs the business needs. Running these committees will include setting agendas, facilitating cross-functional stakeholders, and driving decisions to closure.

• Hold end-to-end ownership of the policy program, including drafting, revising, and maintaining policies across governance domains, and driving stakeholder review and acknowledgment. Manage the company’s Policy Center which hosts all enterprise policies.Own risk management operations, including the risk register, risk assessments, and administration of risk exceptions, including enforcing the 12-month exception cap with mandatory renewal review and required documentation.

• Keep abreast of regulatory and industry developments and advise leadership on the potential impact on the program strategy and plans.

• Ensure program activities align with strategy and manage the timely and high-quality execution of GRC landmarks.

• Drive internal control effectiveness through rigorous internal control monitoring, implementing control enhancements, and providing thought leadership on control design, operations, and supporting processes and policies.

• Perform compliance readiness assessments and provide updates, recommendations, and roadmap to senior management both within Security and to our business partners.

• Advise, educate, and train process and control owners with the preparation and ongoing maintenance of controls and control documentation (e.g., policies, procedures, narratives, and matrices) to better understand the security controls framework and their responsibilities.

• Recommend, develop, and manage the company's risk register, including the definition and reporting on key risk indicators (KRIs) and key performance indicators (KPIs).

• Conduct regular risk assessments and work with relevant departments to identify, evaluate, and mitigate risks across the organization.

• Advise, educate, and train risk owners with the identification, assessment, mitigation, and monitoring of risks to better understand the risk management process and their responsibilities.

• Proactively identify gaps or conflicts in existing policies and processes and work to develop solutions with internal business partners.

• Drive remediation and risk mitigation activities, including root cause analysis and owning the design, tracking, and progress of action plans across compliance, policy, or process gap remediation activities and risk mitigation activities in partnership with internal business partners. Tracks risk trends across cycles and flags recurring patterns before they become repeat findings.

• Design and manage program operations to support the program goals and implement and maintain technology to support the program and its operations.

• Engage in ad-hoc projects as required.

• Maintain regular, clear communication with project teams, key partners, and management regarding the status of controls testing, audit progress, risk assessment progress, and progress of issues management.

• Effectively communicate program and project execution status, program health and effectiveness, key accomplishments, and risks to senior management both within Security and to our business partners.

Must Haves

• 4-7 years of experience in cyber security, technology risk, GRC, and/or technical compliance roles, with at least 2 years focused on ISO 27001 implementation and maintenance

• Demonstrated experience leading at least one full ISO 27001 certification cycle (including the 2022 revision of ISO 27001) from start to finish

• Proven project management experience, including: managing multiple concurrent compliance projects with competing deadlines; leading cross-functional teams across technical and business units; experience with project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall) and tools (ServiceNow, etc.); and a track record of delivering complex compliance projects on time and within scope

• Experience owning or facilitating cross-functional governance programs or committees (e.g., AI governance, data governance, security governance), including running working groups and driving decisions with senior stakeholders

• Strong understanding of security concepts and practical usage, including Information Security Management System (ISMS) implementation and maintenance, control mapping across multiple frameworks, and continuous control monitoring and automation

• Experience implementing and managing compliance programs aligned with ISO 27001 and ISO 27701, including development and maintenance of Statement of Applicability, risk treatment plans and risk acceptance criteria, internal audit programs, and management review processes

• Proven track record working with external auditors, including internal stakeholder management

• Experience with audit automation and continuous control monitoring tools

• Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders and vendors while maintaining project momentum

 Nice to Have

• ISO 27001, 27701, or 42001 Lead Auditor Certification

• CRISC, CISSP, CPA, CISA, PMP, CISM certification(s)

• Experience with NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53 / 171 or other control frameworks

• Familiarity with AI governance frameworks (e.g., ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF)

• Experience preferably at a technology or SaaS / Cloud company and/or with a regulated public company

• 2+ years of Big 4 experience

description:
Headquarters: Remote - Georgia; Remote - Texas; San Francisco, California

 SLSQ327R338

 Databricks is seeking a Lakebase Associate Director Specialists to help customers modernize their operational data foundation with Databricks Lakebase, our fully-managed Postgres offering for intelligent applications. This high-impact role sits within the Lakebase Go-To-Market team and partners closely with regional Account Executives within our Retail vertical to drive adoption of Lakebase with platform, application, and data teams.

 Lakebase gives customers a unified, governed foundation for operational workloads and AI-native applications, helping them move away from a fragmented estate of point databases toward a modern, scalable, serverless Postgres service. If you want to be at the forefront of operational databases for AI and intelligent applications at one of the fastest-growing data and AI companies in the world, this is your opportunity.

 The impact you will have

• Drive new Lakebase revenue by identifying, qualifying, and driving Lakebase activations and consumption within a defined territory, in partnership with regional Account Executives and the broader account team.

• Lead with outcomes for key Lakebase personas — including platform teams and developers, data teams, and central IT — articulating how Lakebase helps them ship features faster, simplify operational data architectures, and improve governance and cost efficiency.

• Sell the value of fully-managed Postgres for intelligent applications, positioning Lakebase as the optimal choice for operational workloads that power real-time, AI-driven experiences.

• Run complex, multi-threaded sales cycles from discovery and value hypothesis through commercial negotiation and close, navigating executive, technical, and line-of-business stakeholders.

• Orchestrate proof-of-value and POCs that validate Lakebase’s benefits for OLTP-style workloads, reverse ETL, and AI/ML-driven applications, in partnership with solution architects and specialists.

• Compete and win against legacy and cloud-native operational databases by leveraging our compete assets, benchmarks, and customer references.

• Align to measurable business outcomes such as performance, developer productivity, time-to-market for new features, cost reduction, and simplification of the operational data landscape.

• Partner cross-functionally with Product Management, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partner teams to shape territory plans, launch plays, and co-selling motions with key ISVs and GSIs.

• Enable the field by sharing Lakebase best practices, success stories, and sales motions with broader sales teams, helping scale Lakebase proficiency across the organization.

 What success looks like in this role

 This role requires the ability to operate across two key motions simultaneously:

• Establish top strategic focus accounts by engaging application development teams to create net-new intelligent applications leveraging Lakebase.

• Drive longer-term Postgres standardization and migration within Databricks' most strategic accounts.

 Candidates should demonstrate how they can act as a force multiplier across multiple dimensions of the business.

 Success in this role requires strength in four areas:

• Business ownership – Operate at a business-unit level by tracking revenue, pipeline, and key observations, and by identifying areas needing additional focus or support.

• Strategic account engagement – Partner with account teams to engage priority accounts across the global DB700, driving strategic opportunities from initial engagement through successful outcomes.

• Field, account, & customer enablement: Align customers and the field on the value of Lakebase by equipping AEs and SAs with the messaging and execution motions needed to confidently own accounts without specialist intervention.

• Market voice and thought leadership – Develop an internal and external presence by contributing to global AMAs and internal forums, and by representing Databricks at key first- and third-party events.

 The interview process is designed to evaluate candidates across all four of these dimensions.

 What we look for

• 7+ years of enterprise SaaS sales experience, consistently exceeding quota in complex, multi-stakeholder deals.

• Proven success selling data platforms, operational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, cloud-native DBaaS), or adjacent data/AI infrastructure to technical buyers and business leaders.

• Strong understanding of modern data and application architectures, including cloud-native services, microservices, event-driven systems, and how operational data underpins AI and analytics strategies.

• Ability to sell to both technical stakeholders (developers, architects, data engineers) and business stakeholders (product leaders, operations, line-of-business owners).

• Demonstrated experience leading specialist or overlay motions, working jointly with core Account Executives to create and progress opportunities.

• Executive presence with the ability to whiteboard architectures, lead C-level conversations, and build trust with senior decision makers.

• Strong value selling skills: adept at discovering pain, building a business case, and tying technical capabilities to clear, quantified outcomes.

• Excellent communication, storytelling, and negotiation skills, with comfort presenting to both large and small audiences.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

 Preferred qualifications

• Experience selling Postgres, operational databases, OLTP workloads, or transactional cloud database services, ideally within large or strategic accounts.

• Familiarity with data platforms, lakehouse architectures, and cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP), including how operational databases fit within broader data and AI strategies.

• Understanding of reverse ETL, real-time decisioning, and operational analytics use cases, and how they drive value for customer-facing and internal applications.

• Exposure to AI-native and agent-driven applications that depend on low-latency, highly scalable operational data services.

• Prior experience in a high-growth, category-creating environment, helping shape new plays, messaging, and customer narratives.

• Experience collaborating with partners and ISVs to drive joint pipeline and co-sell motions.

 About Databricks

 Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. title: Strategic Sales Director, EMEA
description:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

About the role:

As a founding Strategic Sales Director you will focus on some of the largest companies in EMEA, working on big strategic deals that will change the trajectory of the company. You’ll identify and articulate how Cresta can unlock significant value for our customers, build relationships with key executives and evangelize cutting edge AI technology. As an early member of the team at a growing startup, you’ll have the opportunity to help define our sales process, participate in regional expansion strategy and help build the EMEA region, starting with success in the UK.

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment and is passionate about using cutting-edge AI to solve real-world business challenges. You'll help shape our sales strategy, influence cross-functional priorities, and contribute to building a high-performing, customer-obsessed sales culture.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the sales experience while building and managing relationships with key decision-makers and executives
  • Run complex sales cycles from initial contact to close
  • Prospect for new clients, design product presentations and business cases, develop and deliver proposals, negotiate and close contracts
  • Develop a command of the Cresta product, the Contact Center market, our unique competitive differentiators, and our customers’ needs
  • Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Customer Success and Engineering to deliver an exceptional customer experience
  • Own and hit your number

Qualifications We Value:

  • 7+ years of SaaS software sales experience at an enterprise level, with referenceability of consistently delivering to sales quotas in this time
  • Experience negotiating, structuring and executing complex enterprise-level agreements
  • Prior experience leading cross-functional teams through large deal close processes
  • Ability to articulate contractual, technical, and financial value points to customers, including C-level executives
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with experience presenting to C-level executives
  • Ability to be in London easily, often at short notice. Also, the ability to travel domestically and internationally up to around 25% of the time

Perks & Benefits:

We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child
  • Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office
  • Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced
  • 20 days of vacation time to promote a healthy work-life blend

Compensation at Cresta

Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table.

The posted base salary range represents what we expect to pay for this role in a given location. Final offers are shaped by factors like experience, skills, education, and geography. In addition to base pay, total compensation includes equity and a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family.

This role is variable target compensation eligible. There is potential to exceed target earnings when goals are surpassed.

OTE Range: $215,000 – $230,000 Pound Sterling + Offers Equity

Our use of AI in recruiting: We may use AI tools in our recruiting process, which require human review and oversight. If you have questions about our use of AI or wish to opt out, please contact recruiting@cresta.ai (if you are opting out, please use the subject ‘Opt-Out’ in your email).

Recording & AI transcription: We do not authorize candidates to record or use AI transcription of any interview by phone, notetaker app, AI glasses, or other device. Candidates may request an exception or accommodation for review during the interview process as needed.

Recruiting impersonation scams: We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta.ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored.

title: VP of Communications
description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

The VP of Communications owns how TRM shows up in the world: the corporate narrative, the earned channels that carry it, and the voices across the company that amplify it. Criminals are scaling with AI, and TRM is building to own the AI investigations category. You'll build a dedicated communications function from responsibilities currently shared across the team, set proactive narrative strategy on how modern crime is changing and how it's best fought, so that the market, media, analysts, prospective talent, and investors look to TRM for the definitive view on how AI is changing crime, the capacity gap facing the people who fight it, and how crimefighters close it.

The impact you will have:

  • TRM is known as the company that owns the AI investigations category: one clear corporate narrative, carried consistently by our leaders in the conversations that matter, through an executive-visibility program you design and run

  • TRM's share of voice and quality of coverage grow across media, industry analysts, and our other earned channels, shaping how customers, prospective talent, and investors see the company, built on journalist and analyst relationships you own

  • Subject-matter experts from every function become recognized voices in their fields, carrying TRM's story on stages, in bylines, and across our corporate social channels, because you found them, placed them, prepared them, and gave them the guides and AI-enabled workflows to stay consistent and on-brand

  • TRM responds fast and credibly when reputation is on the line, because the monitoring, playbooks, and AI-assisted media tracking you put in place are ready before they're needed

What we're looking for:

  • 10+ years in corporate and executive communications, including owning earned media, ideally at a security, fintech, intelligence, or regulated-tech company

  • A proactive narrative strategist who has placed high-quality coverage and grown share of voice, not just shipped releases

  • Fluency in building sophisticated, credible corporate narratives about AI: what it changes, where it creates risk, and where your company stands, beyond using AI tools day to day

  • An AI-native approach: you use AI across monitoring, research, drafting, and reporting, and you build workflows others can use

  • A natural teacher and talent-spotter who can find the experts across a company, place them in the right forums, and coach them to be confident in front of press and audiences

  • Comfort building a function and its systems from the ground up, and leading cross-functionally without a large standing team

  • Exposure to a strong crisis-communications program and sound judgment under pressure; you've supported a live issue or two, but your instinct is to put TRM into the conversation, not keep it out

  • An excellent writer and editor who can distill complex, technical topics for press, executives, and the public

About the Team:

  • Reports to the Chief Brand Officer, within Brand & Communications

  • A senior leadership role that consolidates communications responsibilities currently split across several people into one dedicated function

  • Works closely with Policy, Insights, Product Marketing, Brand/Content, company Leadership, and subject-matter experts across the company

  • Manages TRM's PR agency and an APAC-based communications lead (contractor) from day one, with potential to build out a team as the function grows

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • US-based role; you'll build coverage for other time zones through your team and partners, starting with an APAC-based communications lead

  • Weekly marketing and leadership syncs; fast, async-first collaboration with executives and cross-functional partners

  • Clear communication norms and shared message guides so the company stays on-brand

Required online and collaboration hours:

  • Schedule: Core overlap across US business hours

On-Call Responsibilities:

  • Schedule: No formal on-call. Crisis-response availability is expected as issues arise.

Travel Requirements:

  • Schedule: Occasional travel for media, executive events, and team offsites

  • Frequency: Low to moderate (HM to confirm)

Onsite Requirements:

  • Schedule: Distributed; periodic in-person for key moments (HM to confirm)

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Within 30 days: ship a corporate narrative and messaging architecture, and a plan to consolidate the split comms responsibilities into one function

  • Within 60 days: land a planned earned-media moment, stand up the executive-visibility calendar, and identify the first group of subject-matter experts to develop as thought leaders

  • Within 90 days: have a tested crisis-communications playbook in place and a repeatable, AI-assisted media-monitoring and reporting workflow running

The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role:

  • Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only.

  • The estimated base salary range for this role is $195,000-$255,000

  • Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.

  • Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

Working closely with Sales Leadership, you will design and deliver targeted 1st-party events, C-level dinners, technical workshops, and partner co-marketing activations. Responsibilities

In this role, you'll:

  • Partner closely with North Sales Leadership and Account Executives to align event programs directly with regional revenue targets and priority accounts across Strategic and New Business segments.

  • Lead end-to-end strategy, content localisation, speaker sourcing, venue management, and execution for proprietary Twilio regional events across key North tech hubs (e.g., London, Stockholm, Copenhagen).
  • Own regional presence at strategic industry conferences and hyper-scaler co-marketing events (AWS, Meta, Google) in partnership with the Partner Marketing Manager.
  • Establish strict lead and attendee follow-up SLAs with regional SDR and AE teams to convert event engagement into qualified pipeline and deal velocity.
  • Develop targeted post-event content and micro-campaigns to enable Account Executives to maintain momentum with enterprise account teams.
  • Measure and report on event success through commercial metrics: target account penetration rate, pipeline created/influenced, deal velocity, and closed-won revenue.
  • Manage the apportioned regional field marketing budget and local vendor relationships to ensure optimal ROI and flawless execution.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply.   • Impeccable English written and verbal communication skills to write compelling local messaging and engage with regional enterprise buyers and agencies.
  • Demonstrated commercial acumen with the ability to act as a trusted peer to Senior Sales Leadership and Enterprise Account Executives.
  • Hands-on experience using CRM and marketing automation tools (e.g., Salesforce, Marketo) to track event ROI, account attendance depth, and pipeline conversion across the funnel.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

*Desired:

Location

This role will be remote, and based in the UK.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to learn from each other. For this role, approximately 25–30% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way across the DACH region.
